snippet.title: SM64 POWER STAR MADNESS - Official Trailer - [AVAILABLE NOW]
snippet.description:
SM64 POWER STAR MADNESS - AVAILABLE NOW!!!
DOWNLOAD IT FROM HERE: "https://romhacking.com/hack/sm64-power-star-madness"

✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮
 ✰SM64 POWER STAR MADNESS - SM64 ROMHACK✰
✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮✮
By: gembai/gamebyte987

✮ I present to you my humble Super Mario 64 RomHack, this is a full lenght hack featuring
141 Power Stars ✰ to collect and have fun! :D

✰ This is my first RomHack, so expect having some issues, I really tested a LOT in order to make sure the least amount of bugs remains, but even with that probable more that one slipped through the cracks. Sorry in advance for that

✮ This hack was primarly tested using Project64 1.6 with Jabo's Direct3D8 1.6, DirectSound 1.6 and DirectInput7 1.6.
- GlideN64 should work too as I tested sometimes with it.
- Also should work on Mupen, but you need to select the dynamic interpreter. 
- Other emulators probably are fine, but those are which I'm sure. Make sure to enable 8MB size on emulator settings.
- Also booted up in parellel launcher to see if works with OGRE plugin (as I'm writing this, didn't know you needed to test it in a specific emulator D;) It seems to works fine with minor graphical issues. But following the flowchart, the optimal should be GlideN64.

✰ Here is a Playlist of songs for those interested :) with info about the songs:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOrKCFmBtMzmiAKiubwmrobLvlSTInk6U&si=jXBzcn2ZDjsEnCk7

✮ Difficulty should be a little harder than sm64. tho is kinda hard to tell how much since I played a lot while making it. The game was 100% completed by me without using savestates multiples times. if you are struggling with something it's ok to use savestates :) tho Idk if something strange happen, if yes. re-open the game. GlideN64 Should work too.

✰ This is been my passion project since a time :D At first I didn't expect to upload it somewhere, so I didn't really pay attention to assets that I took from other places D; sorry about that. but most of them are from SM64, SMSR, SMKDS, SM64DS, MP1 2 and 3, SMG, SMG2, SMB1, SMB2, SMB3, SMW, SMAS, B3313, TheCuttingRoomFloor, SMWCentral, RMDatabase, ZeldaOoT, ZeldaMM, SR, PM, PMTTY, SPM, PMSS, models recourses(mr heck) and probably more than I forgot. Credits to their belongs, ands primarly thanks to Plinzilen64 for creating ROM Manager, to awesome people to did some custom objects of the database, SMW Central for providing  great part of the musics, kaze for showing my hack at the F3 (I'm still embarassed lol) and people who cheers up the project :D (If I left some, sorry I kinda rushed this text D;)

✮console compatibility is NONE (I didn't have a summercart to ever test there, sorry)

✰overall this project was made with love to everyone that wan't to give it a try.

✮I hope you don't find a lot of bugs D; I really tested a lot!!! I swear.

✰This is my very first ROM Hack so It may be faulty of inexperience, sorry in advance.

✮ I hope you like it and have fun! :D

✮✮QoL Version✮✮
I made this little update thanks to the feedback of the people c:
the Quality of Life version includes:
-parallel lakitu camera 
-removed lives system (1ups and 3ups still there as a fun challenge to collect (now heals Mario))
-removed fall damage (make 1 star easier, which is great)
So basically, choose the QoL version or the original as will :)


✰ That pipe? hmm better to forget about it...


DISCLAIMER: THIS CHANNEL IS NOT MONETIZED AND THE ADS ARE JUST PLACED BY YOUTUBE. AND I DON'T SEE A DIME OF THAT :p so consider using an 𝖆dblock𝖊r (at least for my videos) !!!
